title: Contingent liability as asset.
bodyText: Any contingent liability to assessment of members of a domestic mutual insurer does not constitute an asset of the insurer in any determination of its financial condition.
bodyHtml: §431:4-319  Contingent liability as asset.  Any contingent liability to assessment of members of a domestic mutual insurer does not constitute an asset of the insurer in any determination of its financial condition. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]
